mentions.name: context-llemur
mentions.description: This CLI/MCP context management tool lets you easily move your project context around to your favourite LLM clients and IDEs, so you don't have to repeat yourself to LLMs over and over.
mentions.problem: The author got tired of repeating themselves to LLMs over and over.
mentions.audience: Users of LLM clients and IDEs who repeatedly provide the same project context.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I got tired of repeating myself to LLMs over and over so I built context-llemur

https://github.com/jerpint/context-llemur

It’s a CLI/MCP context management tool that allows you to easily move your project context around to your favourite LLM clients/IDEs
